_comment: Saturn palette (UX-DESIGN 4.1) written over the two built-in themes: 'theme-night' (dark) and 'theme-white' (light). The 'Same as system' mode picks one of them. Colors are hex; strokes are 'r,g,b,alpha'. Edit here and rebuild.

common._comment: Not color: UI font stack and corner radii (UX-DESIGN 4.3: buttons 8px, windows 12px). SeoulNamsan is used when installed; Hangul falls back to Malgun Gothic.

sizes._comment: UI sizes (px) for both themes, about 15% above the first Saturn pass (decided 2026-11-18 from previews: text 12, button 28, controls 90 felt 20-30% smaller than MS Office). Upstream modern theme: text 12, button 24, gap 12, controls 84.

layout._comment: Layout numbers the editors keep in JavaScript (Common.Utils.InternalSettings), patched into common/main/lib/util/utils.js at build time. The title row (quick buttons + document name) is 28 upstream; with 32px buttons it needs margin: 32 + 4 + 4 = 40.
